description: Microbenchmark envelope for the turn-12 dispatch-aware DRAM writeback pipeline (stage_expert_outputs + coalesced_writeback) at three production-realistic MoE shapes. Median over WB_ITERS=5 timed runs after WB_WARMUP=2 warmup calls, measured with std::time::Instant. Seed baseline; the bench harness rewrites it when OMLX_BENCH_DUMP=1.
